title: When Jesus arrived… Lazarus had already been dead four days.
paragraphs: When Jesus arrived… Lazarus had already been dead four days.

But heaven wasn’t late.
It was setting the stage.

What if the delay in your life
is actually where the miracle begins?
They thought the story ended at the tomb.

God waited…
so the miracle would be undeniable.

Late to people.
Perfect to God.
Sometimes God doesn’t show up when we want.

He shows up when the moment proves
it could only be Him.
Lazarus thought the story was over.
Some miracles only make sense after the waiting.
